title: Degree project classification verdict
description: Structured output produced by classify.py for a single degree project, using a 23-term IEEE Thesaurus curated taxonomy.

project_id.description: Identifier from the ID column of datosTG.xlsx (e.g., 2018A3).

model_id.description: Ollama model tag used for this verdict (e.g., qwen2.5:14b-instruct).

prompt_version.description: Version tag of the prompt used (matches a file under prompts/).

input_hash.description: SHA-256 prefix over (project_id, prompt_version, source text) — cache key.

input_source.description: full_text if extracted-text/<ID>.txt was available, metadata_only otherwise.

secondary_term.description: Optional second IEEE term to capture a cross-cutting aspect; same enum as primary_term or null.

justification.description: One- or two-sentence justification grounded in the input.

keywords_cited.description: Up to five keywords or phrases from the input that drove the decision.
